text:
ria: quick follow-up from the onboarding RFC thread. yesterday a model made it through canary but later produced bad token alignment in prod logs. not a full outage but noisy. we need a lightweight intake safeguard thats deterministic and cheap to catch tokenization/kv-layout mismatches before benches.

kai: agreed. propose a two-layer fastcheck: (A) inline ABI hash compare (tokenizer spec + vocab fingerprint + kv-format tag) that returns OK/WARN/FAIL; (B) conditional quick-prober (20-150ms) that runs only on WARN to exercise rare-token merges and kv-cache edge ops.

zara: how do we avoid increasing p95 for intakes?

kai: keep layer A <15ms. implement as native lambda in intake with cached catalog lookups. layer B runs async but blocks auto-promotion until it completes; in shadow mode B runs without blocking.

mike: we should parameterize strictness per-team. descriptor flag: "safeguard_mode": "off"|"shadow"|"enforce". default enforce for hosted/dedicated, shadow for labs. also include "allow_once" token for quick bypass in UI.

ria: telemetry is key. emit event safeguard.v2 with fields: model_ref, result, delta_vocab, sample_hash, quickprobe_id. keep diffs tiny (<= 200 bytes). also surface trend dashboard for repeated WARN patterns.

zara: sampling for quick-prober: focus on seq-len extremes + artificially constructed rare-token probes derived from model vocab tail. avoid random sampling.

kai: implementation sketch:
if abi_hash != catalog.abi_hash:
  return FAIL
if vocab_delta > threshold or rare_ratio_diff > threshold:
  return WARN
return OK

mike: rollout plan: 1) implement A + telemetry and run shadow 7d at 5% intakes, 2) implement B quick-prober and run shadow for WARNs, 3) collect FP/FN by replaying FAIL/WARN through full benches, 4) flip to enforce.

ria: ops safety: when FAIL happens, intake UI should show suggested fallback variants and an "allow_once" that requires brief justification. also track allow_once uses per model to detect noisy allowlisting.

zara: additional idea: add a lightweight manifest checksum service (content addressed) so intake can ask for manifest refs instead of shipping sample payloads. helps replayability.

kai: good. owners: kai -> fastcheck lambda + catalog cache; zara -> quick-prober templates + sampling heuristics; mike -> telemetry + UI unblock; ria -> rollout doc + metrics.

onboard-bot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/boards/ONBOARD-4972 and scheduled shadow window 4891300000-4891960000.

ria: sync in 1h to review prototype traces. small action list: kai push PR for A, zara draft probe templates, mike sketch dashboard panels.

kai: ack.

mike: ack.
